full_description: In the KitchenS scene (no sink or microwave), raw food starts on a chopping board. Put the food into the pan on the stove, turn the stove knob up to 180 degrees to cook while watching the pie timer (green then yellow at the food's ideal doneness), then turn the knob back to zero so the timer stops. Success is adequate doneness after the stove is off; leave the food in the pan.
